issue.description:
ADR-001 (Accepted 2026-08-12) specifies a third dependency kind `verifies` plus an advisory structural diagnosis of inverted verification gates (a `blocks` edge whose blocker `verifies` its blocked bead), and forbids title-based heuristics outright. It is marked 'Specified as post-0.1 item R025', the project has shipped well past 0.1 (R010, R028, R038, R040 all have beads), and no open bead covers R025. Work needed: add the `verifies` edge kind to the schema, checkpoint model, dep add/list/show, and the manifest command; implement the advisory inversion diagnostic surfaced through doctor and R023 `why` explanations; never reject the edge at insert time; add conformance tests covering acyclic inverted pairs, deliberate prove-the-baseline-green gates, and round-trip of the new edge kind through checkpoint export/restore, using ADR-001's measured field cases (21 and 24 inverted edges) as fixture scenarios.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Implement the R025 verifies dependency kind and inverted-gate diagnosis (ADR-001)
